{{Top|leg}}
The '''Stalfonauts''' were a group of salvagers. They entered the ruins of the [[Almas Academy]] shortly after its [[Destruction of the Almas Academy|Destruction]], to see what they could find. However, in the Academy's library room, they encountered a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] under the leadership of the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Jacen Yar]] and both groups were wiped out in the resulting firefight.

The bodies of the Stalfonauts were later inhabited by two [[Guardian Spirit]]s, who reanimated the corpses, making them seem to have came back to life.
